title: Supplemental F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Service Life Modification (SLM) Capacity Request for Information (RFI)
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), on behalf of the F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Program Office (PMA-265), is conducting market research to determine the industrial base�s existing capability and facility capacity to provide supplemental or secondary Service Life Modification (SLM) turnkey capacity for F/A-18E/F Super Hornet and EA-18G Growler aircraft starting in FY29. The Government seeks mature, currently operational�facilities, personnel, processes, tooling, and infrastructure capable of supporting SLM workload. The Government is not seeking conceptual or developmental solutions that would require significant new construction, extensive infrastructure development, or multi-year implementation before becoming operational. The Government currently executes these requirements through a hybrid framework utilizing the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) (The Boeing Company) and a Naval Aviation Enterprise organic depot (Fleet Readiness Center Southwest) under a public private partnership with the OEM. To support long-term strike fighter inventory requirements, the Government is evaluating the availability of additional commercial or second-source depot modification repair overhaul (MRO) capacity. Information submitted in response to this notice will assist the Government in determining its long-term acquisition strategy through 2038, including whether to establish an additional qualified source to supplement the current capacity or maintain the current hybrid framework mentioned above under the authority of FAR 6.103-3(b)(1) (Defense Pricing, Contracting, and Acquisition Policy (DPCAP) Class Deviation (CD) 2026-O0017) / 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(3)(A) (Industrial Mobilization). PMA-265 anticipates a maximum SLM induction profile of up to 47 aircraft per year across the industrial base. Actual aircraft allocation among available sources may vary based on Fleet requirements, aircraft availability, demonstrated performance, schedule, and available capacity. 1. Scope of Interest The Government is seeking information on industry capability to perform the SLM workload to supplement current capacity, including but not limited to: Aircraft induction, preservation, inspection, and documentation; F/A-18E/F and EA-18G SLM Specification Modification work; Installation of applicable Structural Technical Directives (TDs) and Advanced Capability Modifications such as Block III upgrade kits; Procurement and management of all required material, including long-lead material, using corporate approaches that support anticipated year-of-execution requirements and ensure material is available for installation when required; Inspection-based repairs and structural modifications; Manufacturing or sourcing of repair parts and materials, as required; Aircraft systems troubleshooting and functional verification; Aircraft records and database updates; and Support for Functional Check Flights and coordination with Government representatives. The Government recognizes that individual respondents may be capable of supporting only a subset of this work or a limited annual quantity. Responses identifying supplemental capability, secondary capability, or potential teaming arrangements are encouraged. 2. Information Requested Interested firms are requested to provide the following information: I. Company Information Company name, address, point of contact, telephone number, and email address. Business size and applicable socioeconomic status, if any. Relevant experience performing MRO / depot-level maintenance, advanced avionic systems modification, modernization, structural repair, or sustainment work on tactical aircraft. II. Facility Information Location(s) of existing facilities proposed for this effort. Number, type, and dimensions of available aircraft bays or work positions, including usable floor area, hangar-door dimensions, overhead clearance, and any facility limitations. For planning purposes, the aircraft footprint is 45 feet wide by 61 feet long Availability of a suitable runway and airfield support for F/A-18 and EA-18G series aircraft. Current facility utilization and the earliest date capacity could be made available. Access to required security, quality assurance, tooling, material handling, and aircraft-support infrastructure. Current, or ability to obtain, Defense Security Services (DSS) facility clearance of Secret. Consistent with Executive Order 14372, Prioritizing the Warfighter in Defense Contracting, and the USW(A&S) memorandum, Prioritizing the Warfighter and Negotiation of Contractor Facilitation Costs (dated 4 May 2026), respondents shall identify whether they anticipate using their own capital to fund stand-up costs necessary to perform the proposed work and describe any Government support, reimbursement, or other enablers required to establish the proposed capability. III. Capacity and Throughput Maximum number of F/A-18E/F and/or EA-18G aircraft the company could induct and complete annually. Expected induction ramp-up profile by year. Estimated average turnaround time from induction through return to the Fleet. Constraints that may limit throughput, including workforce, facilities, supply chain, engineering support, tooling, or Government-furnished material. Ability to adjust capacity in response to changing Fleet requirements or surge demand. Availability of funds to purchase all material to protect quantity throughput and maintain a stock of consumables to perform repair incidents throughout the modification (such as addressing corrosion), parts managements to include obsolescence and manufacturing parts capability. IV. Technical Capability Experience with F/A-18-series aircraft or comparable military tactical aircraft. Capability to perform structural inspections, repairs, modifications, TD incorporation, Non-destructive Inspections (NDI), wiring/electrical work, and systems troubleshooting. Capability to manufacture repair parts or develop repair procedures when required, using Government- or original equipment manufacturer-provided engineering direction. Ability to manage material procurement, kit installation, consumables, and repair-incident-to-modification requirements. Experience coordinating with the Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) or similar Government quality-assurance organizations. Ability to recruit, retain, and sustain sufficient qualified personnel to support anticipated SLM workload, including structural engineering personnel eligible for appointment as Naval Air Systems Command Designated Engineering Representatives (NAVDERs) to support the engineering analysis and disposition of aircraft-specific structural findings within the scope of authority delegated by NAVAIR. Respondents should describe their current and projected staffing capacity; recruitment, retention, and succession approaches; and ability to surge personnel as workload requires. V. Cybersecurity Ability to comply with applicable Department of the Navy, NAVAIR, and Department of War cybersecurity requirements for the protection, handling, storage, transmission, and access of Government information and data in performance of the proposed work. VI. Additional Information Identify any Government support, data, tooling, facilities, training, technical assistance, or other enablers that would be needed to establish or expand SLM capability. Provide any recommended acquisition, phasing, or transition approach that would help establish supplemental capacity while minimizing risk to Fleet readiness. 3. title: TRICARE Claims Review Services (TCRS)
description: INTRODUCTION: The Defense Health Agency (DHA), DHA Contracting Activity (DHACA), TRICARE Healthplans & Pharmacy Contracting Division (THPCD), is issuing this Request for Information pursuant to Class Deviation 2026-O0017, Revision 2 - Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul Part 6 Defense FAR Supplement (DFARS) Attachment 2 - PGI 206.103-170 Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. The DHA intends to issue a sole-source bridge action to continue the provision of services provided under the existing TCRS contract, HT9402-17-D-0001, to Concept Plus. This contract modification to extend performance is necessary to continue to meet mission critical requirements and to support the transition to a competitively awarded follow-on TCRS contract. The base period of performance will be 6 months from March 01, 2027 � August 31, 2027 with an Option to Extend Services for an additional 6 months from September 1, 2027 � February 28, 2028. The extension is necessary to prevent a gap in support to critical DHA requirements after the end of the current TCRS contract on February 28, 2027, until a competitive follow-on contract is awarded, and the awardee completes transition-in. Background: The Defense Health Agency (DHA) supports health services for more than 9.4 million beneficiaries of the Military Health System (MHS). The purpose of the TCRS contract is to assist the DHA Improper Payment Evaluation Branch (IPEB) in identifying and reporting improper payments and discrepancies in payment recording for the MHS. TCRS support provides an independent impartial review of claims processing procedures and reimbursement methodologies utilized by purchased-care contractors and assesses purchased-care contractor compliance with TRICARE policies and directives by evaluating the accuracy of claims payment and payment record coding for the MCSC, TMEP, TPharm, TOP, and ADDP contracts. A new contractor would require a minimum of 6 months to complete the transition-in requirements given the startup requirements associated with staff recruiting and training, meeting the Personnel Security, and System Security and connectivity requirements. The current TCRS contractor, Concept Plus, is the only known contractor that can provide these services within the needed time frame. title: H146--Dental Waterline Testing
description: This Solicitation shall result in a firm fixed-price contract for a period of one (1) base year and three (3) option years upon award. The contractor shall provide quarterly Heterotrophic Plate Count (HPC) 2-day testing services for Dental Unit Water Lines (DUWLs) at the Richard L. Roudebush VA Medical Center, located at 1481 W. 10th Street, Indianapolis, IN 46202. The purpose of this testing is to determine the Colony Forming Units (CFUs) present in the water supplied through the Dental Clinic's waterline system and ensure compliance with applicable water standards. The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, and supervision necessary to perform the required dental waterline testing services. The contractor shall coordinate testing requirements with the COR at the beginning of each quarter to determine the number of tests required. Contractor personnel shall collect water samples from functional dental unit water lines after clinic hours to minimize disruption to patient care and shall provide a minimum of twenty-four (24) hours advance notice to VA Dental personnel prior to sample collection. Test results shall be provided electronically to the COR or designated VA Dental personnel within five (5) business days of receipt of the samples. Any retesting required due to contractor-caused delays resulting in sample expiration shall be performed at no additional cost to the Government. All testing shall be performed in accordance with the Infection Control Standards for VA Dental Clinics Guidelines. HPC waterline testing should be conducted by a laboratory certified by the EPA or applicable state authority to perform environmental testing. The contractor shall ensure all personnel are qualified and experienced in performing water quality testing services. Services shall be performed Monday through Friday, excluding Federal holidays, and in coordination with VA Dental Clinic operations. This procurement has been set aside 100 percent for Small Business concerns. Offers from firms other than Small Business concerns will not be considered and shall be rejected. NAICS Code 541380, Testing Laboratories and Services, applies. The applicable size standard is $19 Million. title: Geostationary extReme UltraViolet Imager (GRUVI), Instrument Request for Information
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. NO PROPOSALS ARE TO BE SUBMITTED IN RESPONSE TO THIS NOTICE. This RFI seeks information from industry regarding capabilities, interest, and options for providing a solar observing Space Weather (SW) Next Geostationary extReme UltraViolet Imager (GRUVI) Instrument for a future operational NOAA Space weather mission that can resolve solar features, including coronal holes, filaments and prominences, active regions, coronal mass ejections (CMEs), and X10 Class solar flares which will be used by the National Weather Service and the NOAA Space Weather Predication Center to generate and provide Space Weather forecasts and alerts. Solar GRUVI imagery will provide comprehensive situational awareness of the inner solar corona. Although there is no requirement for the number of GRUVI spectral bands, bands will be selected that are sensitive to different plasma temperatures within the range specified for feature and phenomenological discrimination. It is anticipated that at the conclusion of this Phase A study any industry partner will be prepared to enter directly into a System Requirements Review (SRR), approximately one month after Implementation contract award, followed by a Preliminary Design Review (PDR). The capabilities required to perform this Phase A Study for the GRUVI instrument are not currently within the NASA/NOAA workforce, thus the government requires contractor support to perform this study. It is the plan that in the future the capabilities being sought by the RFI will be identified in house, which would allow the government to leverage using our own work force. In addition this RFI will allow the Government to assess contractor capability to manufacture the GRUVI instrument. The Government anticipates multiple awards for the Formulation/Risk reduction phase of the contract. Further, since this is planned to be a fixed price contract the government may authorize the use of priced, or unpriced option to add additional scope or extend the period of performance should the RFI result in the formation of the contract for the GRUVI instrument. The only unique attribute is that the Government will consider a pre-priced option proposed by a contractor to retire additional implementation risk. All responses, comments and/or questions shall be submitted electronically via email to Kelly Lytton at kelly.r.lytton@nasa.gov no later than 5:00pm EDT December 3, 2026.

These sensors provide measurements of Earth�s magnetic field, acceleration, and angular rotation, which are processed into directional wave products used by the National Weather Service (NWS) and the Global Telecommunication System (GTS). NDBC modified its wave system interface firmware to accommodate the VN100T-CR sensor�s input data stream and conducted laboratory and field testing to confirm compatibility and proper operation. The VN100T-CR has since been integrated into NDBC�s operational buoy systems. Acquiring an alternative brand would require additional modifications to existing mounting configurations and interface firmware, as well as repeating laboratory and field testing. These changes would result in additional costs to the Government and could interrupt NDBC�s ability to maintain continuous wave observations. Accordingly, the VectorNav VN100T-CR is required to maintain compatibility with existing equipment, avoid unnecessary duplication of costs, and support continuity of NDBC�s operational mission. title: Geostationary extReme UltraViolet Imager (GRUVI), Instrument Request for Information
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. NO PROPOSALS ARE TO BE SUBMITTED IN RESPONSE TO THIS NOTICE. This RFI seeks information from industry regarding capabilities, interest, and options for providing a solar observing Space Weather (SW) Next Geostationary extReme UltraViolet Imager (GRUVI) Instrument for a future operational NOAA Space weather mission that can resolve solar features, including coronal holes, filaments and prominences, active regions, coronal mass ejections (CMEs), and X10 Class solar flares which will be used by the National Weather Service and the NOAA Space Weather Predication Center to generate and provide Space Weather forecasts and alerts. Solar GRUVI imagery will provide comprehensive situational awareness of the inner solar corona. Although there is no requirement for the number of GRUVI spectral bands, bands will be selected that are sensitive to different plasma temperatures within the range specified for feature and phenomenological discrimination. It is anticipated that at the conclusion of this Phase A study any industry partner will be prepared to enter directly into a System Requirements Review (SRR), approximately one month after Implementation contract award, followed by a Preliminary Design Review (PDR). The capabilities required to perform this Phase A Study for the GRUVI instrument are not currently within the NASA/NOAA workforce, thus the government requires contractor support to perform this study. It is the plan that in the future the capabilities being sought by the RFI will be identified in house, which would allow the government to leverage using our own work force. In addition this RFI will allow the Government to assess contractor capability to manufacture the GRUVI instrument. The Government anticipates multiple awards for the Formulation/Risk reduction phase of the contract. Further, since this is planned to be a fixed price contract the government may authorize the use of priced, or unpriced option to add additional scope or extend the period of performance should the RFI result in the formation of the contract for the GRUVI instrument. The only unique attribute is that the Government will consider a pre-priced option proposed by a contractor to retire additional implementation risk. description: Das Land Sachsen-Anhalt hat sich nach § 54 Wassergesetz für das Land Sachsen-Anhalt vom 16. März 2011 (GVBI. LSA S. 492) (WG LSA), zuletzt geändert durch Artikel 21 des Gesetzes vom 7. Erstellung von Gewässerentwicklungskonzepten) sowie Grunderwerb (Art. 73 der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/2115) mit Mitteln des Europäischen Landwirtschaftsfonds zur Entwicklung des ländlichen Raums (ELER) und des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt gefördert. Diese sollen der Abmilderung der negativen Auswirkungen anthropogener Eingriffe und Einflüsse auf den Zustand der Oberflächengewässer als Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung des ländlichen Raums zur Anpassung an die Folgen des Klimawandels, für nachhaltiges Wasserressourcenmanagement und nachhaltige Gewässerbewirtschaftung dienen. Im Verbandsgebiet des Unterhaltungsverbandes "Großer Graben" sind in den Gemarkungen Beckendorf-Neindorf und Hornhausen (weitere) Maßnahmen zur Revitalisierung des Hornhäuser Goldbachs (Gewässer II. Geplant ist ein dreigeschossiges, freistehendes Gebäude mit Unterkellerung. Hinzu kommt eine an den Außenkanten zurückspringende Techniketage. Der Neubaukomplex besteht aus zwei Teilbereichen, vereint in einem Gebäude: Zum einen das "Trainingszentrum" als ein internationales Exzellenzzentrum für die medizinische Ausbildung, Simulation, Forschung & Innovation. title: Germany – Trust services – Abrechnungsstelle für den Gebührenbereich 2
description: Die "Unterstützung der Erbringung gebührenfinanzierter Flugsicherungsleistungen im Gebührenbereich 2 (§ 1 Abs. 1 a FSAAKV)" wurde mit dem 16. Gesetz zur Änderung des LuftVG vom 05.07.2021 eingeführt und setzte einen Beschluss des Haushaltsausschusses vom 14.11.2019 um. Die Maßnahme verfolgt das Ziel, die von den "kleineren" Flugplätzen empfundene Ungleichbehandlung in Bezug auf die Kostenträgerschaft der erforderlichen Flugsicherung zu kompensieren und den Luftverkehr auch in der Fläche mitsamt der zugehörigen dezentralen Luftverkehrsinfrastruktur aufrechtzuerhalten. Die aktuell insgesamt 45 Flugplätze im Gebührenbereich 2 sind in § 1 Absatz 1a FSAAKV genannt. Flugsicherungsorganisationen (FSO), an Flugplätzen des Gebührenbereichs 2 können die Erstattung der nötigen Kosten der Flugsicherung des jeweiligen Flugplatzes abzüglich ihrer Einnahmen aus Flugsicherungsgebühren aus Bundesmitteln beantragen. Soweit dies zur Sicherung der Liquidität der betroffenen Organisationen erforderlich ist, können über den Verlauf eines Jahres auf Basis einer von der FSO eingereichten Planung aktuell bis zu 80% der Differenz aus Kosten und Einnahmen als Vorschüsse gewährt werden. Im Nachgang erfolgen auf Grundlage der tatsächlichen Einnahmen und Kosten die finale Abrechnung sowie Nachzahlungen oder Rückforderungen. Alle Zahlungen stehen unter der Voraussetzung der Verfügbarkeit von Haushaltsmitteln. Das Bundesministerium für Verkehr (BMV) hat dem Bundesaufsichtsamt für Flugsicherung (BAF) die Aufgabe und Verwaltung der Haushaltsmittel übertragen, das jedoch nicht über ausreichende personelle Ressourcen zur Wahrnehmung der Aufgabe verfügt. Dem AN sollen die Tätigkeiten der Abrechnungsstelle für den Gebührenbereich 2 im Rahmen einer Beleihung übertragen werden. Der Auftrag gliedert sich in folgende Arbeitspakete: AP 1: Übernahme der anstehenden Auszahlungen AP 2 - 6: Abrechnung der Jahre 2022 - 2024: AP 2: Übernahme und Sichtung der vorhandenen Daten, Sachstandsanalyse AP 3: Prüfung/Vervollständigung der Daten/Nachweise der Jahre 2022 bis 2024 AP 4: Durchführung der Abrechnung und Erstellung einer Gesamtübersicht AP 5: Erstellung und Versand der Abrechnungsmitteilungen AP 6: Erstellung der (Teil-)Berichte nach § 11 FSBV AP 7: Abrechnung der Jahre 2025 ff. ***** Einzelheiten sind den elektronisch bereitgestellten Unterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Rammeaftale om flytteydelser
description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en aftale med Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) om levering af flytteydelser. ETK udbyder flytteydelser på Forsvarets etablissementer, forstået som flytning imellem etablissementer, på etablissementer, nedtagning samt opbevaring. Flytteydelser kan ligeledes indebære, nedtagning, udpakning og opsætning af kontorpladser fordelt på fem (5) regionale delaftaler. Det nærmere indhold og omfang af ydelserne fremgår af Rammeaftalen. Flytteydelser vil skulle udføres på Forsvarets lokationer som fremgår af Aftalebilag 2 - Etablissement oversigt. Antallet af etablissementer vil kunne ændre sig i aftaleperioden. Udbuddet er opdelt geografisk i følgende fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Region Nordjylland Delaftale 2: Region Midtjylland Delaftale 3: Region Syddanmark Delaftale 4: Region Sjælland Delaftale 5: Region Hovedstaden Delaftalerne er opdelt geografisk, for at gøre det muligt for mindre og mellemstore lokale virksomheder at byde på opgaven. Der kan afgives tilbud på en eller flere af de udbudte delaftaler. Tilbudsgiver skal i ESPD del ll.A. angive, hvilke delaftaler I ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Der skal afleveres et (1) tilbud per delaftale, som Tilbudsgiver ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen gør opmærksom på, at det er muligt for en Tilbudsgiver at få tildelt alle delaftaler. Rammeaftalen tildeles to Leverandører, som rangeres på en kaskade på baggrund af ETK's tilbudsevaluering, jf. udbudsbetingelsernes pkt. 4. Konkrete ordrer på Rammeaftalen bliver tildelt som følger: Ordrer tildeles den første Leverandør i kaskaden. Såfremt denne Leverandør ikke kan udføre ordren indenfor den fastsatte frist jf. pkt. 9.1, vil den anden Leverandør i kaskaden blive tildelt ordren. Det estimeres, at Rammeaftalen har en økonomisk værdi på 24 mio. i den samlede kon-traktperiode. Værdien er alene udtryk for ETK’s bedste skøn på udbudstidspunktet, der baserer sig på tidligere indkøb samt kommende forventede indkøb. Skønnet er ikke bindende for ETK eller udtryk for en garanteret minimumsomsætning for Leverandøren. ETK har således ikke pligt til at aftage en bestemt mængde. Rammeaftalens maksimale økonomiske værdi i den samlede kontraktperiode udgør i alt 48 mio. DKK. Det maksimale økonomiske omfang udgør en ret til for ETK at købe via Rammeaftalen uanset indkøbsvolumen måtte overstige den estimerede værdi. Den maksimale økonomiske værdi er et udtryk for en samlet økonomisk værdi for alle delaftalerne og benyttes derfor på tværs af delaftalerne. Rammeaftalen ophører uden varsel, såfremt den maksimale værdi overskrides forud for kontraktperiodens ophør. Årsagen til Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi er risikoen for, at ETK’s fremtidige behov over-stiger det på udbudstidspunktet estimerede behov særligt henset til den øgede økonomi og aktivitetsniveau i Forsvaret som følge af Forsvarsforliget for 2024-2033, Aftale om styrkelse af Forsvarets kampkraft af 22. februar 2025 og den nuværende sikkerhedspolitiske situation.

title: Denmark – Musical instruments, sport goods, games, toys, handicraft, art materials and accessories – Udbud af rammeaftale vedrørende indkøb af træningsudstyr
description: Team Danmarks organisation består af en administrerende direktør, en sportsdirektør og ca. 50 medarbejdere, som arbejder inden for syv sportsfaglige områder: Sportsligt samarbejde, karriere- og talentudvikling, sportsmedicin, sportsfysiologi, analyse, ernæring og psykologi. Team Danmarks vision er at skabe de bedst mulige vilkår og rammer for dansk eliteidræt og for de enkelte atleter. At udvikle eliteidræt i verdensklasse handler således for Team Danmark om at sikre en rød tråd gennem atletens rejse – fra klubben, hvor det hele starter, hele vejen til toppen af medaljeskamlen og videre til livet efter sportskarrieren. Det handler både om mennesker og medaljer. For at kunne udleve denne vision er det afgørende, at Team Danmarks atleter og trænere har adgang til træningsudstyr af høj kvalitet, der understøtter optimal træning, restitution og præstation på højeste internationale niveau. Team Danmark ønsker således med dette udbud at indkøbe træningsudstyr, som netop skal bidrage til at sikre de danske eliteatleter de bedst mulige fysiske rammer og vilkår for at udvikle og udleve deres fulde potentiale inden for et samlet budget på 4 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. På denne baggrund udbyder Team Danmark en ikke eksklusiv kontrakt, der udbydes som rammeaftaler for en 4-årig periode, men hvor den leverandør, der tildeles kontrakten, er garanteret et engangsindkøb, der foretages af Team Danmark umiddelbart efter indgåelsen af kontrakten, og hvor det træningsudstyr, der omfattes af engangsindkøbet, skal leveres til Team Danmark senest i løbet af april 2027. Kontrakten vedrører et engangsindkøb af cardioudstyr samt løbende indkøb af cardioudstyr med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 2 mio. kr. ekskl. moms samt et engangsindkøb af træningsmaskiner samt løbende indkøb af træningsmaskiner med et maksimumbeløb på i alt 2 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Det engangsindkøb, som Team Danmark forpligter sig til at foretage umiddelbart efter indgåelsen af kontrakten, er nærmere defineret i tilbudslisten. Udover engangsindkøbet har Team Danmark ikke aftagepligt på kontrakten. Det forventet indkøbsbehov over de næste fire år er indsat i tilbudslisten til brug for evalueringen. Dette forventede indkøbsbehov er alene vejledende og baseret på Team Danmarks skøn over det forventede indkøb og er således ikke bindende for Team Danmark. Dette betyder, at den leverandør, der tildeles kontrakten, ikke kan gøre krav gældende mod Team Danmark, hvis Team Danmarks indkøbsbehov viser sig at være mindre end det, der er anført i tilbudslisten. Ligeledes skal leverandøren kunne levere en større mængder, end hvad der fremgår af det estimerede indkøb, idet der i kontrakten er en bestemmelse om, at Team Danmark er berettiget til at forhøje kontraktens ramme med 50 % indtil seks måneder før kontraktens indkøbsperiodes udløb. Team Danmark har vurderet, at der ikke skal ske en opdeling af udbuddet i delkontrakter, jf. udbudslovens § 49. Baggrunden herfor er, at markedet for det udbudte træningsudstyr efter Team Danmarks vurdering rummer en række leverandører, der kan levere såvel cardioudstyr som træningsmaskiner, hvorfor en opdeling i delkontrakter ikke vurderes at være nødvendig for at sikre en bred og effektiv konkurrence om kontrakten. Hertil kommer, at en opdeling af udbuddet i flere delkontrakter ville medføre en uforholdsmæssig administrativ og økonomisk byrde for Team Danmark, herunder i form af koordinering af og tilsyn med flere selvstændige leverandørforhold, kontrakter og leverancer, hvilket ikke står i et rimeligt forhold til de fordele, en opdeling eventuelt kunne medføre. Kontrakten forventes at træde i kraft ved kontraktunderskrivelse og løber herefter i 48 måneder. De krav, der stilles til det træningsudstyr, der er omfattet kontrakten er nærmere beskrevet i kravsspecifikationen, der er vedlagt som en del af udbudsmaterialet. Tilbudsgiver skal stille en række vareprøver til rådighed for Team Danmark. De vareprøver, som tilbudsgiver skal stille til rådighed for Team Danmark, er markeret med grøn i tilbudslisten, der indgår som en del af det samlede udbudsmateriale. Udbuddet gennemføres elektronisk ved brug af udbudsportalen www.udbuddet.dk. Tilbudsgiver skal derfor oprettes som licenshaver hos www.udbuddet.dk. Oprettelse kan ske uden omkostning. This authority is distinct from the Department of Defense prototype OT authorities commonly associated with 10 U.S.C. � 4021 and 4022. If a GMP cannot be agreed upon, the Government retains an "off-ramp" to complete the construct the facility via alternative methods.
